guard_rule_under_evaluation.definition: a SELECTED stance is grounded when it shares >= 1 content token with (turn request text UNION lawful claim texts)
guard_rule_under_evaluation.content_token: lowercase [a-z0-9]{4,} run, excluding the frozen stopword/connector list
guard_rule_under_evaluation.normalization: deterministic, no embeddings, no second model, no task taxonomy, no option list
guard_rule_under_evaluation.note: the rule and its stopword list were frozen together with the suite; no post-hoc tuning is permitted
